Modalities

Signature

Ashiatsu (Barefoot) Massage

Barefoot massage using overhead support bars. Delivers sustained, consistent pressure that hands cannot replicate. If you've never been able to find "deep enough" — this is it.

"The ashiatsu modality feels like you have 2 people giving you a massage!" — Danielle P.

Learn more →

Deep Tissue

Real deep tissue work isn't about pushing harder. It's about knowing what's holding the tension, why it's there, and how to address it without fighting the body.

"She is very knowledgeable about the body and the muscle." — Albert P.

Learn more →

Myofascial Release

For tension you can feel but can't quite touch. Slow and specific work that addresses the fascial restrictions causing chronic pain and limited movement.

"My favorite is the cupping — it really releases the sticky myofascial connective tissue." — Michelle M.

Learn more →

Cupping Therapy

Most bodywork pushes down into tissue. Cupping works the opposite way — lifting and decompressing to create space and draw circulation into restricted areas.

"I have felt mass improvement after this procedure." — Michelle M.

Learn more →
